name: kml-merge-provenance
description: MERGE provenance survives chained merges: the source's own `_merged_from` entries ride along, deduplicated, and a replayed merge self-diagnoses as already merged (KIP §4.4). The two merges run in setup.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?cat_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Category"} } CONCEPT ?a { {type: "Category", name: "CatA"} } CONCEPT ?b { {type: "Category", name: "CatB"} } CONCEPT ?c { {type: "Category", name: "CatC"} } }
MERGE CONCEPT ?dup INTO ?canonical WHERE { ?dup {type: "Category", name: "CatA"} ?canonical {type: "Category", name: "CatB"} }
MERGE CONCEPT ?dup INTO ?canonical WHERE { ?dup {type: "Category", name: "CatB"} ?canonical {type: "Category", name: "CatC"} }

cases.name: the first source's trail rode along with the second merge
replaying the merge reports not found with an already-merged hint
cases.command: MERGE CONCEPT ?dup INTO ?canonical WHERE { ?dup {type: "Category", name: "CatB"} ?canonical {type: "Category", name: "CatC"} }
